calculate_L31: calculate the L31 neoclassical transport coefficient using trapped particle fraction, electron collisionality, and effective charge
calculate_L32: calculate the L32 neoclassical transport coefficient from electron-electron and electron-ion contributions
calculate_alpha: calculate the alpha coefficient accounting for ion temperature gradient and ion-electron collision effects
test_calculate_L31: test the L31 coefficient calculation with trapped fraction, collisionality, and Z_eff inputs
test_calculate_L32: test the L32 coefficient calculation with electron-electron and electron-ion contributions
